info.title: bbx — Bitbucket Cloud CLI
info.description: gh for Bitbucket Cloud. A .NET global tool for the Bitbucket Cloud API v2: repositories, pull requests, branches, tags, commits, source files, downloads, pipelines, snippets, workspaces and projects. JSON on stdout and meaningful exit codes, so scripts and LLM agents can consume it.
